description: This file implements a session storage-backed state management utility for the Upload page in a web application. It provides functions to load, save, clear, and build the persisted state related to file uploads, email contents, document type, and extracted JSON, specifically tailored to work with sessionStorage and avoid persisting non-serializable objects like File instances.

methods.name: safeJsonParse(raw)
methods.description: Safely parses a JSON string, returning null on failure or if input is falsy.

methods.name: serializeFileMeta(file)
methods.description: Creates a serializable metadata object from a File object, including name, size, type, and lastModified.

methods.name: loadUploadPageState()
methods.description: Loads and parses the persisted upload page state from sessionStorage.

methods.name: saveUploadPageState(state)
methods.description: Serializes and saves the upload page state to sessionStorage.

methods.name: clearUploadPageState()
methods.description: Removes the upload page state from sessionStorage.

methods.name: buildPersistedUploadState({ docType, file, emailContents, hasSubmitted, extractedJsonRaw })
methods.description: Constructs a plain object representing the current upload state, including document type, email contents, submission status, file metadata, raw JSON, and timestamp.
